title_en: Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd., Zhengye Electric Appliance Industry Co., Ltd. of Gaoming District, Foshan City, Guangdong Zhengye Electric Appliance Co., Ltd. v. Zhengye Electric Appliance Co., Ltd. of Shunde District, Foshan City, Guangda Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. of Shunde District, Foshan City — dispute over unfair competition
ruling_gist_en: According to Article 2 and Article 5(3) of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the PRC, using the same characters as another person's registered trademark as the trade name in one's enterprise name for similar goods, thereby causing the relevant public to be confused as to the source of the goods or services, even if not prominently used, still constitutes an act of unfair competition. Enterprise names, especially trade names, differ from personal rights in the general sense; they are commercial identifiers that distinguish different market entities and are essentially property rights and interests. After an original enterprise is dissolved, if its debts and claims are succeeded by a subsequent enterprise, the relevant rights and interests arising from the trade name are also succeeded by the subsequent enterprise. In terms of civil liability, if the use of a later trademark infringes upon the rights and interests of a prior trade name and constitutes an unfair competition act, the court shall order the cessation of the use of the infringing registered trademark.
keywords_en: Civil; unfair competition dispute; retrial; Supreme People's Court; Guangdong Province; legal person; Anti-Unfair Competition Law; whether using another person's registered trademark characters as an enterprise trade name constitutes unfair competition; succession of trade name rights and interests after enterprise dissolution; civil liability for conflict between a registered trademark and a prior trade name; reversal of judgment; trademark licensing; change of enterprise name; succession of trade name rights and interests; conflict between trademark and trade name; good faith; unfair competition; application for retrial; unfair competition dispute involving a group limited company
full_text_en:
Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd., Foshan Gaoming District Zhengye Electric Industrial Co., Ltd., Guangdong Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. v. Foshan Shunde District Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd., Foshan Shunde District Guangda Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. — dispute over unfair competition

Ruling Summary

According to the provisions of Article 2 and Item (3) of Article 5 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, using characters identical to those in another person's registered trademark as a trade name in a business name on similar goods, thereby causing relevant members of the public to confuse the source of the goods or services, constitutes an act of unfair competition even if the characters are not used prominently. A business name, especially its trade name, is different from a personal right in the general sense; it is a commercial identifier that distinguishes different market entities and is essentially a property interest. Where the original enterprise is dissolved and its creditor's rights and debts are assumed by a subsequent enterprise, the relevant rights and interests arising from the trade name are also assumed by the subsequent enterprise. In terms of civil liability, where the use of a subsequent trademark infringes upon the prior rights and interests in a trade name and constitutes unfair competition, a judgment shall be made ordering the cessation of the use of the registered trademark that constitutes infringement.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

Civil Retrial No. 36 (2008)

Applicants for Retrial (Plaintiffs at First Instance, Appellees at Second Instance): Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 13 Huan'an Road, Ronggui Town, Shunde District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Lin Chaoqun, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Rao Dehe, lawyer of Guangdong Haidisen Law Firm.

Applicants for Retrial (Plaintiffs at First Instance, Appellees at Second Instance): Foshan Gaoming District Zhengye Electric Industrial Co., Ltd., domiciled at Baishi Development Zone, Genglou Town, Gaoming District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Lin Changmao, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Rao Dehe, lawyer of Guangdong Haidisen Law Firm.

Applicants for Retrial (Plaintiffs at First Instance, Appellees at Second Instance): Guangdong Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd., domiciled at Genghe Town, Gaoming Cangjiang Industrial Park, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Lin Chaoming, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Rao Dehe, lawyer of Guangdong Haidisen Law Firm.

Respondents (Defendants at First Instance, Appellants at Second Instance): Foshan Shunde District Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd., domiciled at Industrial Zone 1, Dawan Haigangcheng, Leliu Town, Shunde District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Lin Kunren, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Tan Weiping, lawyer of Guangdong Tianlun Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Fang Qingsong, lawyer of Guangdong Tianlun Law Firm.

Respondents (Defendants at First Instance, Appellants at Second Instance): Foshan Shunde District Guangda Enterprise Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at Longsheng South Road, Leliu Town, Shunde District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Lu Zhanhong, General Manager.

The Applicants for Retrial, Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Weixiong Group), Foshan Gaoming District Zhengye Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Gaoming Zhengye), and Guangdong Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangdong Zhengye), being dissatisfied with the Civil Judgment (2003) Yue Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 17 rendered by the Guangdong High People's Court in the case of a dispute over unfair competition with the Respondents, Foshan Shunde District Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shunde Zhengye) and Foshan Shunde District Guangda Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shunde Guangda Group), filed an application for retrial with this Court. This Court rendered the Civil Ruling (2005) Min San Jian Zi No. 15-1 on June 8, 2008, approving the retrial of this case. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and held a public hearing in this case. Lawyer Rao Dehe, agent ad litem of the Applicants for Retrial Weixiong Group, Gaoming Zhengye, and Guangdong Zhengye, and lawyers Tan Weiping and Fang Qingsong, agents ad litem of the Respondent Shunde Zhengye, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The Respondent Shunde Guangda Group, having been properly served with summons by this Court, failed to appear in court. This case is now concluded.

On August 31, 2001, the Plaintiffs at First Instance, Weixiong Group, Gaoming Zhengye, and Guangdong Zhengye, filed a complaint with the Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province, alleging: The first plaintiff, the predecessor of Guangdong Weixiong Group, Shunde Weixiong Group, registered the trademark "正野GENUIN" in 1996, used on goods in Classes 6, 7, 9, 11, 28, 32, 39, and 42, and licensed the second and third plaintiffs to use it as a trademark and as a trade name in their business names. The first plaintiff established Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company on June 25, 1994, and licensed the use of the characters "正野" to it as a trademark, business name, and design. The characters "正野" became known to a broad consumer base through various means, serving as a distinguishing mark between the plaintiffs' products and others. Through long-term and extensive promotion by the three plaintiffs, the "正野" trademark and its products have gained relatively high reputation, recognition, and goodwill in the market. The first defendant, Shunde Zhengye, knowing that "正野" was a well-known trademark and trade name created by the three plaintiffs, established a company identical to the plaintiffs' former Shunde Zhengye Company when the plaintiff's subsidiary Shunde Zhengye Industrial Company relocated from Shunde City to Gaoming City on May 14, 1998. The second defendant, Shunde Guangda Group, applied to register the trademark "正野ZHENGYE" on goods such as switches and sockets in June 1997 and licensed it to the first defendant. Since 1999, the first defendant has been using "Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. (Sino-Japanese Joint Venture)" on its products, packaging, promotional materials, advertisements, etc., causing misidentification by the relevant public. The acts of the two defendants violated the principle of good faith and caused serious damage to the plaintiffs. The complaint requested the court to: 1. order the two defendants to cease using the characters "正野" in acts of unfair competition; 2. order the defendants to compensate the plaintiffs for economic losses of RMB 2,000,000; 3. order the two defendants to issue an apology to the three plaintiffs and eliminate adverse effects; 4. order the first defendant, Shunde Zhengye, to change its business name and not use the characters "正野"; and 5. order the two defendants to bear the litigation costs and agency fees of RMB 53,500 in this case.

The two defendants jointly replied: The trade name "正野" of Shunde Zhengye originated from a license from its shareholder enterprise, Leliu Zhengye Company. That company, through its own efforts, has become a well-known enterprise, and the "正野" trademark has become well-known in the switch and socket industry. Shunde Guangda Group legally registered the trademark "正野ZHENGYE", approved for use on goods in Classes 3, 7, 9, and 11, and also registered the trademark "正野电工" on Class 9. Weixiong Group's lawsuit against Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye regarding trademark rights lacks factual and legal basis. The trademarks are different, and the designated goods fall into different similar groups. Shunde Zhengye's use of the "正野ZHENGYE" trademark was legally licensed by Shunde Guangda Group. Guangdong Zhengye and Gaoming Zhengye have no prior right to use the trade name "正野". The business name of Shunde Zhengye was legally registered and approved by the Shunde Administration for Industry and Commerce. There is no conflict between the business name rights of the parties.

The Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province found at first instance:

The predecessor of Weixiong Group, Shunde Weixiong Group, applied to register the trademarks "正野GENUINE" and "正野GENUIN" in August 1994 and December 1994 respectively, and obtained registration in July 1996 and November 1996 respectively, approved for use on goods in Class 11, i.e., ducted exhaust fans, air conditioners, ventilation fans, and sterilizers. On January 15, 1995, Shunde Weixiong Group licensed the "正野GENUIN" trademark to Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company for use on ventilating fans and air pressure regulators it produced. After the trademark was registered, a formal trademark license contract was signed on January 15, 1997, licensing the trademark to Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company for a ten-year period free of charge. Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company was renamed from Shunde Fujiada Company in September 1994. Shunde Weixiong Group later underwent restructuring and changed to Weixiong Group. In March 1999, the registrant of the two above-mentioned trademarks was changed to Weixiong Group.

Gaoming Zhengye was established in May 1996. On January 15, 1997, Shunde Weixiong Group and Gaoming Zhengye entered into a trademark license contract, licensing the two above-mentioned trademarks to Gaoming Zhengye free of charge.

On April 30, 1998, Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company applied for dissolution due to insufficient space for production expansion. All personnel and equipment of the company were transferred to Gaoming Zhengye, and all outstanding creditor's rights and debts were assumed by Gaoming Zhengye in full. Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company was approved for dissolution on May 14, 1998.

Guangdong Zhengye was renamed from Gaoming Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. in August 2001. Gaoming Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. was renamed from Gaoming Xionghui Electric Co., Ltd. on February 18, 1999. In October 1999, Weixiong Group licensed the "正野GENUIN" trademark to Gaoming Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd.

After Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company, Gaoming Zhengye, Guangdong Zhengye, and its predecessor Gaoming Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. were licensed to use the above trademarks, they engaged in long-term production and sales, participated in exhibitions and product launches, produced and distributed promotional brochures, and conducted sustained long-term promotion of the Zhengye trademark in Mainland China and overseas through media, store signs, light boxes, etc. The total annual advertising expenditure from 1995 to 2001 was over RMB 28.91 million. In December 2000, the "正野GENUIN" trademark was rated as a Guangdong Province Famous Trademark. Shunde Zhengye Industrial Company and Guangdong Zhengye used packaging and labels with a modified font design of "正野" to sell their products, and the "正野" products were marketed throughout the country. From 1999 to 2001, the total sales revenue of Gaoming Zhengye was RMB 125,838,600, and that of Guangdong Zhengye was RMB 152,405,838.29, totaling RMB 278,244,438.29.

Shunde Guangda Group was established on September 7, 1995, producing and selling household appliances, lighting apparatus, etc. On May 29, 1997, Shunde Guangda Group applied to register the trademark "正野ZHENGYE", which was approved for registration on September 28, 1998, approved for use on Class 9 goods, i.e., electrical plugs, sockets, and other contactors. On October 23, 1998, He Jianhua, former head of the Advertising and Planning Department of Shunde Guangda Group, established Shunde Leliu Town Zhengye Electric Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Electric Factory), mainly engaged in electric rice cookers and water heaters. On December 18, 1998, two shareholders of Shunde Guangda Group contributed capital to establish Shunde Leliu Town Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd., with He Jianhua as legal representative, mainly engaged in household appliances, gas appliances, lighting electrical appliances, etc. On December 31 of the same year, the Electric Factory ceased operations. On February 8, 1999, Shunde Leliu Town Zhengye Electric Co., Ltd. and Japan Xinling Limited Company jointly established Shunde Zhengye, producing and selling electric fans, plugs and sockets, air conditioners, etc. On February 18, 1999, Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye entered into a trademark license contract, licensing the "正野ZHENGYE" trademark to Shunde Zhengye free of charge for a period ending in September 2008. On June 30, 1999, the foreign shareholder of Shunde Zhengye, Japan Xinling Limited Company, changed its name to Zhengye Limited Company. From October 1999 onwards, Shunde Zhengye used the characters "正野ZHENGYE" prominently on promotional materials, promotional newspapers, sales premises, price lists, packaging boxes, packaging bags, etc. for its switches and sockets.

The Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province held at first instance:

Since 1995, the three plaintiffs and their predecessors have continuously used and promoted the "正野GENUIN" trademark. Their products have a relatively high reputation among similar goods and services. The trademark has become known to the relevant public through various channels and should be recognized as a well-known trademark. After the dissolution of Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company, the relevant rights and interests arising from the trade name "正野" were transferred to Gaoming Zhengye for exercise. Moreover, this trade name has been continuously used by the plaintiffs since September 1994 and has become a well-known trade name. The defendant Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye, together with Weixiong Group, are all located in Shunde City. However, in 1997, they applied to register the trademark "正野ZHENGYE", which is similar to the plaintiff's "正野GENUIN" trademark, clearly indicating an intention to free-ride on the plaintiff's well-known trademark and cause confusion among consumers. The defendant Shunde Guangda Group, in violation of the principle of good faith and basic business ethics, registered a mark imitating another's well-known trademark. Its actions constitute unfair competition. The defendant Shunde Zhengye registered and used the trade name "正野" with an obvious intention to free-ride on another's goodwill. It prominently used the characters "正野" and "正野电工" on its products, packaging, and promotional materials, using them as product identifiers and trade names, causing misidentification and confusion among consumers. Its actions constitute unfair competition. Pursuant to Article 1, Article 2, and Article 20 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 134, Items (1), (2), and (10) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the court rendered the Civil Judgment (2001) Fo Zhong Fa Zhi Chu Zi No. 84 on November 28, 2002, holding:

1. Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye shall immediately cease using the characters "正野" from the date this judgment takes effect.
2. Shunde Zhengye shall immediately cease using the trade name "正野" in its business name from the date this judgment takes effect, and shall apply to the Shunde Administration for Industry and Commerce for a change of its business name. If it fails to change the name within the time limit, the court may forcibly change it.
3. Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye shall, within thirty days from the date this judgment takes effect, publish an apology notice on the first page of the Yangcheng Evening News, apologizing to the three plaintiffs and eliminating adverse effects (the content is subject to court approval).
4. Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye shall, within ten days from the date this judgment takes effect, compensate the plaintiffs for economic losses of RMB 500,000 and pay the plaintiffs' reasonable expenses of RMB 52,533 incurred in this case, totaling RMB 552,533. For delayed payment, interest on the debt during the period of delayed performance shall be doubled according to the loan interest rate for the same period of the People's Bank of China.
The case acceptance fee of RMB 20,010 and the audit fee of RMB 5,500, totaling RMB 25,510, shall be jointly borne by the two defendants.

Shunde Guangda Group and Shunde Zhengye, being dissatisfied with the first instance judgment, appealed to the Guangdong High People's Court, arguing: 1. They lawfully own the "正野ZHENGYE" trademark and a lawfully registered business name. The first instance judgment ordering the appellants to cease using the characters "正野" violates the Trademark Law and the Provisions on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration. 2. The first instance judgment unlawfully expanded the scope of protection for the appellees' "正野" trademark and trade name. Only well-known trademarks can obtain cross-class protection. 3. The appellees do not have prior rights to the "正野" trademark and trade name. 4. The appellants had no subjective bad faith in registering and using the "正野ZHENGYE" trademark and the trade name "正野"; they did not prominently use the name "正野". 5. The goods used by the appellants and the appellees are different and will not cause confusion. They requested the annulment of the first instance judgment and dismissal of the appellees' claims. Weixiong Group, Gaoming Zhengye, and Guangdong Zhengye argued in response that the first instance court correctly found the facts and applied the law.

The facts found by the Guangdong High People's Court at second instance were essentially consistent with those found at first instance.

The Guangdong High People's Court held at second instance:

According to the provisions of the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China, the exclusive right to use a registered trademark is limited to the trademark as approved for registration and the goods as approved for use. Since the "正野GENUIN" trademark of Weixiong Group is not a well-known trademark, relevant provisions on special protection and expanded protection for well-known trademarks do not apply. Since the registration date of Shunde Zhengye's business name was earlier than the date when Weixiong Group's "正野GENUIN" trademark was rated as a "Guangdong Province Famous Trademark", it did not violate the Interim Measures for the Recognition and Administration of Guangdong Province Famous Trademarks. The act of registering its business name did not infringe Weixiong Group's trademark rights. Shunde Zhengye lawfully obtained the right to use the "正野ZHENGYE" trademark through authorization from Shunde Guangda Group. It did not prominently use its business name and did not infringe Weixiong Group's exclusive right to use its trademark. The statutory scope of protection for a business name is to prohibit others in the same administrative region and same industry from registering identical or similar business names. Although the trade name in the business names of Shunde Zhengye and Gaoming Zhengye is the same, the administrative divisions are different, belonging to "Shunde City" and "Gaoming City" respectively. The distinction between different enterprises is obvious. Gaoming Zhengye's claim that Shunde Zhengye's registration of its business name infringed Gaoming Zhengye's right to its business name lacks legal basis. Guangdong Zhengye's use of the business name "正野" occurred later than the registration date of Shunde Zhengye's business name, and the administrative division levels are different. Guangdong Zhengye's claim that Shunde Zhengye's registration of its business name infringed its right to its business name also lacks legal basis. Based on Shunde Guangda Group's trademark license, Shunde Zhengye used the trade name "正野" in its business name with a lawful right basis and legitimate reason. There is no evidence that confusion will occur between the two. Shunde Weixiong Group registered the "正野" trademark, and Shunde Zhengye's use of the characters "正野" in its business name does not violate the Anti-Unfair Competition Law. Furthermore, the former Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company was dissolved and ceased to exist. Gaoming Zhengye merely used the characters "正野" as a trade name in its own business name. Such use of an identical trade name does not constitute inheritance or continuation of a business name. The first instance court's finding that Gaoming Zhengye continued the business name of the former Shunde Zhengye Electric Industrial Company was improper. Pursuant to Paragraph 1, Item (2) of Article 153 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 3 of the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 3, 4, and 6 of the Provisions on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration, the court rendered the Civil Judgment (2003) Yue Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 17 on April 9, 2004, holding: The first instance judgment was set aside, and the claims of Weixiong Group, Gaoming Zhengye, and Guangdong Zhengye were dismissed. The litigation costs of both instances totaling RMB 50,020 were to be borne by Weixiong Group, Gaoming Zhengye, and Guangdong Zhengye.

Weixiong Group Company, Gaoming Zhengye Company, and Guangdong Zhengye Company applied for retrial on the following grounds: 1. This case is a dispute over conflict between a trademark and an enterprise name. Shunde Guangda Group Company and Shunde Zhengye Company violated the principle of good faith, and their conduct constituted unfair competition, which should be adjusted by applying the General Principles of the Civil Law and the Anti-Unfair Competition Law. The judgment of the second instance applied the Trademark Law and the Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration, which was an improper application of law. 2. The trade name is the main basis for distinguishing different market entities and, as a property right, can be transferred and inherited. The judgment of the second instance, which held that Gaoming Zhengye Company could not succeed to the trade name of Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company, lacked legal basis. 3. The registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE" subsequently obtained by Shunde Guangda Group Company was unrelated to goods in the category of "ventilating fans and lighting," but Shunde Zhengye Company used the trade name "正野" in its related products and also used the company name "Zhengye Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd.," demonstrating an intent to cause confusion among relevant public as to the business operators and the source of the products. 4. According to the provisions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, when resolving conflicts between prior trademarks and enterprise names or trade name rights, the prior legally obtained rights should be protected. Determining whether the conduct of Weixiong Group Company and Gaoming Zhengye Company constituted unfair competition is related to, but not a necessary condition for, whether their trade name is well-known or famous. The judgment of the second instance erred in finding that since the establishment date of Shunde Zhengye Company was earlier than December 2000, when Weixiong Group Company's trademark was recognized as a well-known trademark of Guangdong Province, no infringement was constituted. A request was made to rescind the judgment of the second instance.

The respondent, Shunde Zhengye Company, argued in its defense that the trademark "正野ZHENGYE" of Shunde Guangda Group Company was lawfully registered with the Trademark Office of the State Administration for Industry and Commerce and was used in accordance with the law. The enterprise name containing the trade name "正野" used by Shunde Zhengye Company was also lawfully registered and recorded, and the use of the registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE" was legally authorized and licensed by Shunde Guangda Group Company. Therefore, there was no act of unfair competition. The facts found by the court of second instance were clear, and the application of law was correct.

The facts found upon retrial by this court are consistent with those found by the original trial court, and this court confirms them.

Opinion of the Court on Retrial: This case is a dispute over unfair competition. Based on the claims of the plaintiff at first instance, the focus of the dispute in this case is whether the following acts constitute unfair competition: Shunde Guangda Group Company applying for registration of the trademark "正野ZHENGYE" in Class 9 that is identical or similar to Weixiong Group Company's registered trademark "正野GENUIN" in Class 11; Shunde Guangda Group Company and Shunde Zhengye Company using the registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE"; and Shunde Zhengye Company using an enterprise name containing the trade name "正野".

(1) Whether Shunde Guangda Group Company's application for registration of the trademark "正野ZHENGYE," which is similar to Weixiong Group Company's trademark "正野GENUIN," constitutes unfair competition.

Weixiong Group Company claims that Shunde Guangda Group Company's registration of a trademark similar to its own constitutes unfair competition. The essence of this claim is a dispute over the authorization of Shunde Guangda Group Company's "正野ZHENGYE" trademark. Weixiong Group Company and Shunde Guangda Group Company respectively own the registered trademarks "正野GENUIN" in Class 9 and "正野ZHENGYE" in Class 11. According to the facts found by the original trial court, no act of using the registered trademarks beyond the scope of authorization was found for either company. For disputes involving two registered trademarks, the Trademark Law has provided relevant administrative procedures for resolving disputes over registered trademarks. This court will not hear this issue.

(2) Whether Shunde Zhengye Company's use of the trade name "正野," which is identical to the word portion of Weixiong Group Company's registered trademark "正野GENUIN," constitutes unfair competition.

In 1995, Weixiong Group Company licensed the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company to use the trademark "正野GENUIN" and registered this trademark in Class 11 for ventilating fans in 1996. Through advertising by Weixiong Group Company and Gaoming Zhengye Company and the sale of related goods, by the time Shunde Zhengye Company was established in February 1999, the trademark "正野GENUIN" had already acquired a certain degree of fame. Shunde Zhengye Company used the word "正野," which is identical to the word in another party's registered trademark, as the trade name in its enterprise name to produce products such as switches and sockets. In the building materials market and daily life, the sales channels and consumer targets for products such as exhaust fans, ventilating fans, switches, and sockets are substantially the same. The conduct of Shunde Zhengye Company is sufficient to cause the relevant public to be confused as to the source of its goods or services. Although Shunde Zhengye Company's use of the trade name "正野," which is identical to the word portion of Weixiong Group Company's registered trademark "正野GENUIN," was not in a prominent manner, it still constitutes an act of unfair competition.

(3) Whether the use of the registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE" by Shunde Guangda Group Company and Shunde Zhengye Company constitutes unfair competition against Gaoming Zhengye Company's trade name "正野."

Enterprise names protected by the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, especially trade names, are different from personal rights in the general sense; they are commercial identifiers that distinguish different market entities and are essentially a type of property right. According to the facts found by the original trial court, in May 1994, the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company began using the trade name "正野." Gaoming Zhengye Company was established in May 1996. On April 30, 1998, the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company was merged into Gaoming Zhengye Company. After the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company was dissolved, its creditor's rights and debts were all succeeded by Gaoming Zhengye Company, and the related rights arising from the trade name could also be succeeded by Gaoming Zhengye Company.

The former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company began using the trade name "正野" in May 1994 and, in January 1995, obtained authorization from Weixiong Group Company to use the trademark "正野GENUIN." After Gaoming Zhengye Company was established, it also used the trademark "正野GENUIN" pursuant to a trademark license agreement with Weixiong Group Company. Through advertising by the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company and Gaoming Zhengye Company and the sale of related goods, the trade name "正野" and related products had already acquired a certain degree of market recognition and were known to the relevant public. In February 1999, Shunde Guangda Group Company licensed the registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE" to Shunde Zhengye Company for use in producing and operating household electric fans, plugs and sockets, air conditioners, etc. Shunde Zhengye Company used the words "正野ZHENGYE" in prominent positions on its promotional materials for switches and sockets, promotional newspapers, sales venues, price lists, packaging boxes, packaging bags, etc. The conduct of Shunde Guangda Group Company and Shunde Zhengye Company in using the trademark "正野ZHENGYE" was sufficient to cause the relevant public to mistakenly believe the source of the goods, thereby infringing upon Gaoming Zhengye Company's prior rights in the trade name "正野," and constituted unfair competition.

(4) Whether Shunde Zhengye Company's use of the same trade name "正野" as Gaoming Zhengye Company and Guangdong Zhengye Company constitutes unfair competition.

Weixiong Group Company, Gaoming Zhengye Company, and its predecessor had continuously used the trade name "正野" and the trademark on products such as ducted exhaust fans, air conditioners, and ventilating fans since 1995. Through advertising and product sales, this trade name had gained a certain influence among the relevant public. Shunde Zhengye Company, being in the same region as Weixiong Group Company and the former Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Company, was aware of the fame of the "正野" trademark and the "正野" trade name. Nevertheless, it used the trade name "正野," identical to the enterprise name trade name of Gaoming Zhengye Company, to produce and operate electric fans, plugs and sockets, air conditioners, etc. This conduct was sufficient to cause the relevant public to be confused about the source of the goods or services and constituted unfair competition. The judgment of the second instance, which held that since the establishment date of Shunde Zhengye Company was earlier than December 2000, when Weixiong Group Company's registered trademark "正野GENUIN" was recognized as a well-known trademark of Guangdong Province, and that Shunde Zhengye Company had legally authorized rights and justifiable reasons for using the trade name "正野" based on its licensed use of the registered trademark "正野ZHENGYE" from Shunde Guangda Group, applied the law incorrectly.

Guangdong Zhengye Company's use of the word "正野" as its enterprise trade name occurred later than the establishment date of Shunde Zhengye Company. During the hearing of this court, Guangdong Zhengye Company explicitly waived its claim that Shunde Zhengye Company constituted unfair competition. This court grants permission for this waiver.

In summary, this court holds that the grounds for the retrial application by Weixiong Group Company and Gaoming Zhengye Company are partially established and should be supported. The judgment of the second instance applied the law incorrectly and should be corrected. In accordance with Article 134, paragraph (1) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 2, 5(3), and 20 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 186, paragraph (1) and Article 153, paragraph (1)(2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Rescind the Civil Judgment No. (2003) Yue Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 17 of the Guangdong High People's Court;

2. Amend Item 1 of the Civil Judgment No. (2001) Fo Zhong Fa Zhi Chu Zi No. 84 of the Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province to: Shunde Guangda Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. and Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd. shall immediately cease using the trademark "正野ZHENGYE" that infringes upon the trade name rights of Gaoming Zhengye Company's "正野," effective from the date this judgment takes effect;

3. Amend Item 2 of the Civil Judgment No. (2001) Fo Zhong Fa Zhi Chu Zi No. 84 of the Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province to: Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd. shall immediately cease using the trade name "正野" in its enterprise name, effective from the date this judgment takes effect;

4. Amend Item 3 of the Civil Judgment No. (2001) Fo Zhong Fa Zhi Chu Zi No. 84 of the Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province to: Shunde Guangda Group Company and Shunde Zhengye Company shall, within thirty days from the date this judgment takes effect, publish an apology notice on the first page of the Yangcheng Evening News, offering an apology to Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd. and Gaoming Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Co., Ltd. and eliminating the adverse effects (the content must be approved by the court);

5. Amend Item 4 of the Civil Judgment No. (2001) Fo Zhong Fa Zhi Chu Zi No. 84 of the Foshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province to: Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd. shall, within ten days from the date this judgment takes effect, compensate Guangdong Weixiong Group Co., Ltd. and Gaoming Zhengye Electrical Appliances Industrial Co., Ltd. for economic losses in the amount of RMB 500,000, and pay the reasonable expenses incurred in this case totaling RMB 52,533, making a total of RMB 552,533.

If the obligation to pay monetary amounts is not fulfilled within the period specified in this judgment, interest on the debt for delayed performance shall be paid at double the rate in accordance with Article 229 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

The total case acceptance fees for the first and second instances of RMB 50,020 and the audit fee of RMB 5,500, totaling RMB 55,520, shall be borne by Shunde Zhengye Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd.

This judgment is the final judgment.
